steps.content: Night descends upon WhiteSands, and with it comes a storm that carries calamity and anomaly in its howling winds. It scours the desert, swallowing every shelter in its path. Merchants, bandits, and sand worms alike flee before its relentless approach.
Yet amidst this all-consuming Tide of Ashes, a single structure stands defiant upon the shifting sands. It cleaves the surging, dust-choked waves, an immovable and unyielding bastion.
The place is a ruin, a colossal steel tomb frozen in time. Within its walls, ghostly soldiers throw open the gates, forming ranks to welcome their general.
That night, her affairs in the city concluded and her desired meetings held, Augustus returns to her fortress.
As she walks through the long corridor, a smile touches her lips while listening to Siglinde's remote debriefing on the past few days.
On the other end of the line, the liaison officer's voice is composed and professional as ever, yet Augustus can immediately sense the high spirits thrumming beneath the victory report.

steps.speaker: Siglinde
steps.content: Thanks to your support, our frontline squad was able to adapt quickly. We repelled the enemy and secured significant spoils, completing our mission with honor.

steps.speaker: Siglinde
steps.content: Frankly, the FAC's combat awareness pales in comparison. They're overly defensive, their tactics are rigid, and their hesitation is costing them opportunities. It's difficult to believe they're DisCity's primary force...

steps.speaker: Siglinde
steps.content: General, if I may, are you still considering taking over their position? You haven't mentioned it since our breakthrough at their base. If the plan is still active, I could infiltrate their ranks, using my liaison position to gather intelligence and influence their operations from the inside.

Though her voice is measured and calm, the young liaison officer's quickening speech gives her away. Augustus recognizes the thrill coursing beneath her professional demeanor. The approach of war has a scent, a charge in the air that calls to every "Rancor" soldier's blood—a feeling she knew well in her youth.
After a moment of contemplation, she answers.

steps.speaker: Augustus
steps.content: Hmm... I have other plans, but your initiative has my attention.

steps.speaker: Augustus
steps.content: Very well. Get in close to that Commander-in-Chief. Observe him. I trust you'll see the FAC's true nature for yourself.

steps.speaker: Siglinde
steps.content: The mission is clear. I will not fail you, General.

Augustus ends the communication, that faint smile lingering on her lips. She enters the situation room at the corridor's end and shuts the door, sealing the howling storm outside. Now, she stands alone in this vast, empty chamber.
Yet beneath the echo of her footsteps hums a chorus of countless other voices... the whispers of the "Rancors."

steps.speaker: Rancors
steps.content: <color=#dg1f1f><i>The time has come <size=28><color=#7683a2>It's finally time</size></color>. The rusty scent of war <size=28><color=#7683a2>The call of blood</size></color>...<i></color>

steps.speaker: Rancors
steps.content: The city-state needs me DisCity needs me. The enemies are on their way, bringing back glory victory and justice homeland to us. Our courage undiminished Our resolve unextinguished, we still thirst for the demons' blood, to cement our loyalty with it to protect our city-state.

steps.speaker: Rancors
steps.content: Take us back Bring us back to the battlefield, General. Lead us Command us, let us kill let us die, just like... in days past.

Whenever Augustus amplifies her power through her subordinates' Rancors, she hears their voices, just as her soldiers do. And each time she returns to Nirvana Port, those voices grow clearer, sharper.
They rise from beneath her feet and emanate from the hilt at her waist, as if the entire ruined bastion trembles with whispers, welcoming her home.
Augustus always listens quietly, tracing familiar faces among them, reclaiming moments lost to time. Still listening, she moves past rows of bookshelves.
At last, she draws out a dossier—not too thick, not too slim—with writing on its cover:

<i>N.F. 62, DisCity Independence War Report

Recorder: <size=52><color=#fb9259>Big</color> Boss</size> Brock<i>

steps.speaker: Augustus
steps.content: ...That old fossil. Can't even file a proper war report without turning it into a joke.
She smiles to herself and opens the weathered pages.
